controls: DA old versus DA new: same prediction and blur sigma, transition only
E4 old versus E4 new: same prediction and blur sigma, transition only
DA versus E4 at each fixed transition
visual_method: Direct inspection of recomputed raw-effect overview, consecutive-frame contact sheets and native-resolution early ROI; no real-time full-video playback claimed
selection: Uniform whole-clip overview, fixed middle window, and window containing largest new-threshold model difference; post-hoc diagnostic selection
findings: New thresholds preserve more train/passenger/track/support detail in inspected frames while clouds and late trees remain blurred.
DA and E4 under the same new thresholds are nearly indistinguishable at inspected scale; no clear visual application improvement attributable to E4.
Thin structure boundaries retain softening or halos; perfect foreground protection is unsupported.
quantitative_interpretation: Blur weights and RGB output differences describe application changes, not semantic retention accuracy, depth accuracy or perceptual quality.
limitations: No foreground/background labels, ideal blur reference or depth GT
Only specified samples and consecutive windows inspected visually
Application thresholds were adjusted after seeing the test clip; not independently validated optimal parameters
Whole-image means may conceal localized errors
previous_user_observations: Preserved in conversation and previous records as preliminary observations, not adopted as final evidence
